name: Game Jam
description: Deliberately tiny, so the whole set fits a weekend. Grow it after the jam if the game sticks.

pillars.name: One Fun Verb
pillars.feeling: the single action is fun on its own

pillars.name: Understood in Seconds
pillars.feeling: anyone gets it without a tutorial

gameExamples.heading: Pitch
gameExamples.text: Bounce a ball through a shrinking arena for as long as you can.

gameExamples.heading: Core Loop
gameExamples.text:
1. Start.
2. Bounce.
3. Survive.
4. Die and restart.

gameExamples.heading: Non-goals
gameExamples.text:
- Menus beyond start and restart.
- More than one mechanic.

docs.title: Core Loop
docs.summary: The one thing the player does, over and over, and why it's fun.

examples.heading: The Player Can
examples.text:
- As a player, I can learn the main action within seconds.
- As a player, I can get better at it each attempt.

examples.heading: The Player Sees
examples.text:
- Immediate feedback on every action.
- My score or progress always on screen.

examples.heading: Rules
examples.text:
- One input does the main action.
- A round lasts under two minutes.

docs.title: Prototype Code
docs.summary: Where the jam code lives, and the shortcuts taken to finish in time.

examples.heading: How It Works
examples.text: Everything lives in one module; Blueprints are fine. Shortcuts are listed so they can be fixed after the jam.

examples.heading: Data
examples.text: - Tuning values exposed on the Blueprints.

docs.title: Jam Assets
docs.summary: Every asset in the game, and the packs they came from.

examples.heading: Assets Needed
examples.text:
| Asset | Type | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player sprite or mesh | Mesh | Placeholder | To source |
| Arena | Mesh | Placeholder | To source |
| Sounds | Sound | Placeholder | To source |
| Music track | Music | Placeholder | To source |

examples.heading: Style
examples.text: Flat colors and simple shapes that are quick to make or find.

examples.heading: What to Look For
examples.text:
- Free asset packs with a matching style.
- CC0 sound packs.

examples.heading: What to Avoid
examples.text: - Assets that take longer to integrate than to replace.

docs.title: Menus
docs.summary: Title screen, the minimum HUD and a way to restart.

examples.heading: The Player Can
examples.text:
- As a player, I can start a game from a title screen.
- As a player, I can restart instantly after losing.

examples.heading: The Player Sees
examples.text: - My score on the game-over screen.
